per_id_review.remaining_gap_or_uncertainty: June 2025 Los Angeles workplace raids are supported by contemporary reporting; nationwide E-Verify, quota coordination, and general warrantless-search claims are not.
The Brennan Center page supports the described plan proposals. The Heritage chapter PDF was not independently read here; proposals must remain attributed and must not be described as implemented.
2017 denial is documented; later 2021 rule changes status. Do not present the 2017 decision as current blanket approval.
Transcript supports the announced instruction to halt funding pending review, not actual amounts, duration, or payment implementation.
DOJ instrument supports pardon, offense, docket, and sentence. No source establishes Trump’s rationale or corruption.
DOJ clemency instrument supports time-served commutation and terms; stated rationale is attributed to White House. Scheme detail beyond that statement remains unavailable.

AP tracker page supports existence of a generic promise-tracking project, but packet identifies no dated pledge, status, criterion, or discrete Trump event; exclude from event timeline unless generic tracker records are in scope.

The Senate interview PDF exceeds retrieval size and could not be read; an archive guide supports only a general FHA inquiry. Need readable primary transcript or credible event-specific account; no official FHA blacklist/sanction record is supplied.

No verified condominium transaction, counterparties, financial trail, or money-laundering finding is supplied. The NYT tenant-dispute article was inaccessible and its headline cannot support the accusation.

TPM supports reported requests through unofficial Russian email accounts and a FinCEN official’s concern; it says what information was exchanged is unclear. No proof of successful disclosure, infiltration, official finding, or Trump direction.
CNN supports the meeting and reported strategy discussion. The meeting does not establish improper agreement or the senators’ eventual votes.
Bloomberg supports Trump’s public statement. No implementing directive or evidence that every wind/solar approval ceased is supplied; electricity-price assertion remains attributed.
The Guardian feature is literary coverage and its Trump mention is hypothetical; it supplies no Trump event to place on the timeline.

Cointelegraph reports NYT’s approximate 60% finding using mixed dispositions. NYT could not be read; exact denominator and matter-by-matter changes remain unverified, and political favoritism is not established.
House Clerk confirms 215–214 passage. CBO estimates apply to House-passed text, stated time window and January 2025 baseline; projections are not observed effects or estimates for enacted text.

Hearing transcript supports temporary restoration based on likely Fifth Amendment due-process injury and no First Amendment ruling; Reuters supports later permanent restoration. Video provenance/sole cause is not established.

DOJ supports conviction and eight-month sentence. Reuters/AP sources map the alleged malware drive to authorities, but AP pages were inaccessible; malware use, espionage, and routine access claims remain unsupported.
